lines.text: Your own door at your back, and the valley in front of it. Whoever has been raiding out here came through in the night, and did not bother to hide it.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Tracks on the road out. Two days old, and heavy — they were carrying somebody's winter out.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Then we follow them, as far as it goes.

lines.speaker: Toln
lines.text: A whole raiding band, and this many of us. I'd like the record to show I said that out loud.
